snippet.title: Primal Rage Playthrough Talon
snippet.description:
Primal Rage Playthrough with Talon
Most Difficult Setting (16)

Finally after a long time and a broken PC I finished Talon's Playthrough! Talon is the fastest Character and has a lot of variety! I had a hard time with him because the CPU will counter most of his moves immediately!

Enjoy! ^^
